title: Chain formula for the unit projection mate on resolving pairs
statement: Fix ringed sites, closed derived tensor structures A,A′ and simultaneous models T,T′, exact additive F,G with an adjunction F left adjoint to G, a site functor and section pull maps, and ordinary/cochain open tensor data D as in [def-sf-open-tensor-cochain-data]. Fix a restriction tensor isomorphism with a TensorComparisonModel as in [def-sf-open-tensor-representative-data], whose ordinary isomorphism is D.pullTensor. Fix one-flat comparisons ambientModel and openModel compatible with T,T′ on simultaneous K-flat inputs. Let alpha be any natural transformation from F(A′(M,GN)) to A(FM,N) whose adjunct is A′(eta_M,1) followed by the inverse restriction comparison. For flat-term K-flat complexes C on the open site and P on the ambient site, compose Q(D.chain(C,P).hom), the inverse exact-F factorization, F of the open one-flat comparison, F of the tensor map induced by the inverse exact-G factorization on P, and alpha at (QC,QP). This equals the ambient one-flat comparison for (FC,P) followed by the tensor map induced by the inverse exact-F factorization on C. This only asserts a chain comparison square on resolving pairs; it does not assert that alpha is invertible or give a formula for arbitrary C.

proof.text: Apply the canonical adjunction-transpose resolving-pair calculation to the mate determined by restriction and the adjunction unit.
The supplied hypothesis halpha identifies alpha with this canonical mate by injectivity of the adjunction hom-equivalence, so rewriting gives the displayed equation.

theorem openTensorProjection_mate_resolving
    (D : OpenTensorCochainData.{c, v, r} J R J' R' F G adj H sectionPull)
    (restriction : A.tensor ⋙ G.mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (G.mapDerivedCategory.prod G.mapDerivedCategory) ⋙ A'.tensor)
    (restrictionModel : TensorComparisonModel.{c, v, r} J J' R R' G A A' T T' restriction)
    (hordinary : restrictionModel.ordinary = D.pullTensor)
    (ambientModel : RingedDerivedTensorComparison.{c, v, r, (max c v r) + 1} J R A)
    (ambientBoth : RingedDerivedTensorBothModel.{c, v, r, (max c v r) + 1} J R A T ambientModel)
    (openModel : RingedDerivedTensorComparison.{c, v, r, (max c v r) + 1} J' R' A')
    (openBoth : RingedDerivedTensorBothModel.{c, v, r, (max c v r) + 1} J' R' A' T' openModel)
    (alpha : (𝟭 _).prod G.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ A'.tensor ⋙ F.mapDerivedCategory ⟶
      (F.mapDerivedCategory.prod (𝟭 _)) ⋙ A.tensor)
    (halpha : ∀ M N,
      (SheafOfModules.OpenTensorNormalization.exactDerivedAdjunction adj).homEquiv _ _
          (alpha.app (M, N)) =
        A'.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom
            ((SheafOfModules.OpenTensorNormalization.exactDerivedAdjunction adj).unit.app M)
            (𝟙 (G.mapDerivedCategory.obj N))) ≫
          restriction.inv.app (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj M, N))
    (C : CochainComplex (SemilinearSections.Mod.{c, v, max c v r} J' R') ℤ)
    (P : CochainComplex (SemilinearSections.Mod.{c, v, max c v r} J R) ℤ)
    (hC : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J') (R := R') C)
    (flatC : flatTerms.{c, v, r} J' R' C)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := R) P)
    (flatP : flatTerms.{c, v, r} J R P) :
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (D.chain C P).hom ≫
        F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app ((totalTensor.{c, v, r} J' R').obj
          (C, (G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ≫
        F.mapDerivedCategory.map ((openModel C ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (Or.inr (restrictionModel.kflat P hP flatP))).hom) ≫
        F.mapDerivedCategory.map (A'.tensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) (G.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app P))) ≫
        alpha.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C, DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) =
    (ambientModel ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C) P (Or.inr hP)).hom ≫
        A.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app C) (𝟙 _))
